title: On this day in space! Nov. 5, 2002: NASA's Galileo spacecraft flies by Jupiter moon Almathea only to find it's a 'pile of icy rubble less dense than water'
caption:
NASA’s Galileo mission revealed that the moon Amalthea isn't a solid rock. It's a low-density, icy mess.

Source: Space - On this day in space! Nov. 5, 2002: NASA's Galileo spacecraft flies by Jupiter moon Almathea only to find it's a 'pile of icy rubble less dense than water'
